Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (December 18, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Doc4607851696 Description: For the Design, Setup, Printing, Bar Coding, Laser Imaging, Household Sorting, Canada Post Letter Carrier Pre-Sort and Mailing of the Voter Information Cards / Notices for Election Events, for a period of one (1) year from the date of award, with the option to renew the Contract on the same terms and conditions for up to four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods.
